name: Buildaster
summary:
One player knows the plan. The other has to build it.

Buildaster VR is an asymmetrical co-op game where communication is your most important tool. One player wears the VR headset while another follows the architect's blueprint on a phone or web browser. Every wall, window, piece of furniture, and decoration depends on how well you work together.

Complete increasingly challenging construction projects, solve communication mistakes, and watch a miniature blueprint transform into a life-sized room around you
